form.title: QUALITY ACCEPTANCE FORM
form.objective: To collect and analyze samples from the top and bottom of the tank truck upon arrival.
procedure: Have the driver collect 600 ml or more of sample from the top of the tank truck and from the bottom of the tank truck.
Check the two samples for odor, color, trash, temperature, and reject as soon as possible if any of these parameters are out of spec.
File Acceptance Form in Lab drawer file.
Attach to this form, any certificate of analysis that may be supplied by the vendor.
